scope: Supplementary computational sources, validation support, documentation and derived numerical reporting
archive_correspondence: Each files[].sha256 identifies the public file at files[].path, relative to the repository root. archived_source_binding identifies its archived source or supporting record where available. A verified historical hash describes the archived copy.
public_adaptation: Public documentation, file names, launcher interfaces and display text may differ from the recorded runs. Archived run contracts preserve their original source digests.
archive_locations: Paths beginning with archives/ are identifiers for external preserved execution records. They are not paths inside this repository.

role_definitions.numerical_implementation: Scientific calculation, evaluation or training implementation.
role_definitions.execution_entry_or_launcher: Workflow entry or scheduling interface; alternatives can share the same numerical implementation.
role_definitions.numerical_reporting: Aggregation, numerical reports or scientific figures.
role_definitions.validation_support: Tests and synthetic fixtures; not scientific result-generating entries.
role_definitions.derived_statistical_reporting: New reporting derivation verified against preserved numerical outputs.
role_definitions.configuration_or_dependency: Settings, source identities, compatibility records or environment requirements.
role_definitions.documentation: Instructions and scientific definitions; not executed scientific code.
role_definitions.numerical_verification_record: Numerical checks of preserved results or corrections to previously reported summaries.
role_definitions.numerical_reference_report: Reference values extracted from empirical model or control outputs.

statistical_reporting_sources: preserved field and transition bootstrap summaries

files.origin: Derived reporting from preserved numerical outputs; not an original model-training or bootstrap-generation program.
